description:
PCSsole is a dedicated foot health brand committed to transforming everyday comfort through innovative, high-quality insoles. Designed for people who live active, demanding lives—whether hiking 100 miles a week, standing 10 hours a day, or walking the dog—PCSsole empowers everyone to move pain-free. Our mission is to blend science, style, and sustainability to create insoles that support healthier feet and happier lifestyles. With a focus on unique designs and universal fit, PCSsole is redefining foot comfort for all.

Product Description

PCSsole insoles are expertly crafted to provide exceptional comfort and support for a variety of lifestyles and foot conditions. Our product line includes:

  • Orthotic Insoles: Designed for conditions like plantar fasciitis, flat feet, and high arches, offering strong arch support and shock-absorbing cushioning.
  • Comfort Insoles: Made with high-density foam and gel for all-day wear, perfect for casual shoes, sneakers, or work boots.
  • Specialty Designs: Unique patterns and colors not found elsewhere, adding a touch of personality to functionality.
  • Universal Fit: Easily trimmed to fit any shoe size, from athletic sneakers to dress shoes, ensuring versatility for men and women.

Payment Terms

To attract and retain motivated affiliates, PCSsole’s affiliate program offers competitive and transparent payment terms:

  • Commission Rate: 10-15% per sale (tiered based on performance):
    • 10% for 1-10 sales/month.
    • 12% for 11-20 sales/month.
    • 15% for 21+ sales/month.
    • 30% for 50+ sales/month
  • Cookie Duration: 30 days, ensuring affiliates earn commissions on purchases made within 30 days of a click.
  • Average Order Value (AOV): Estimated at $40-$60, meaning affiliates can earn $4-$9 per sale at the base rate.
  • Payout Schedule: Monthly, processed on the 15th, with a minimum payout threshold of $50 to reduce admin costs.
  • Payment Methods: PayPal, direct bank transfer, or store credit (optional for affiliates wanting PCSsole products).
  • Bonuses: Seasonal incentives (e.g., 5% extra commission during holiday campaigns) and performance bonuses (e.g., $100 for top 5 affiliates monthly).
  • Promo Support: Affiliates receive exclusive discount codes (e.g., “PCS10” for 10% off) to share with their audience, boosting conversions.
payout_period: Quarterly on the 15th for payout timing.
